bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms or by phone. When booking, choose a counter seat at L'Atelier, facing the open kitchen, or a table in the Le Jardin dining room. Every booking needs a credit card guarantee, completed by midnight on the day the booking is made.
cancellation: Changes and cancellations must be made at least 48 hours ahead; later ones cost HK$500 per guest.
groups: There is a private dining room with a minimum spend. Half the minimum spend is taken as a deposit, which is not refundable; changes made 7 or more days ahead can be moved to another booking within 3 months.
dressCode: Smart casual. Men must wear long trousers, closed shoes and a shirt or top with sleeves; vests, sleeveless tops, shorts, sandals and flip-flops are not accepted.
children: Children aged 8 and over are welcome.
byob: Outside food and drink, including wine and birthday cakes, is not accepted.
